title: Google DeepMind makes Genie 4 interactive world model available in preview
summary: Google DeepMind released Genie 4 in preview for Google AI Ultra subscribers and early-access API partners, enabling real-time steerable 720p simulation generation at up to 24 frames per second with native synchronized audio.
research_notes:
Access the Project Genie preview interface in a supported browser using an authorized Google AI Ultra account, or obtain early-access developer credentials for the Gemini API in Google AI Studio.

Provide an initial world prompt consisting of a descriptive text scenario or an input reference image to initialize the 3D environment.

Navigate the generated environment in real time at 720p up to 24 frames per second using keyboard, mouse, or gamepad directional controls.

Issue mid-session natural language text or voice steering commands to modify environmental conditions, objects, or scene dynamics on the fly.

Keep interactive simulation sessions bounded to short durations of one to two minutes to prevent cumulative environmental drift and maintain visual coherence.

Avoid rapid 360-degree camera rotations to minimize loss of object permanence and scene background hallucinations.

Use first-person perspective navigation when exploring generated spaces, as wide third-person views exhibit higher scale and physical distortion.
